gaps.where: Workflows → Runs, press a run: the header (version N / draft revision N, started, ended, “Finished: They replied”), The path it took (“X and Y weren’t used”), and each step’s panel (Done/Failed/Skipped, tries, the note, the text or email it sent, Checks before the text, Knowledge used, What it was set to do, What came back, Error, Approval: Approved by Priya with an edit…)
gaps.gap: No tool returns a run's details. workflow.run_get is read only in runState (to find the stuck step and its error for list_workflow_runs and manage_workflow_run) and in context.ts pageDetails (only the workflow name and customer). Even on a run's own page, the Assistant can't say: version or test revision, started and ended times, why it ended (endReason in words), which path it took, what each step sent, decided or got back, the knowledge it used, or who approved or rejected it and with what edit. The screen-reads test misses this because ownReads() only matches the query name.
gaps.fix: Add an auto look-up get_workflow_run {runId} (permission workspace.read) in packages/core/src/assistant/tools-content.ts, implemented in apps/worker/src/assistant/tools-content.ts on workflow.run_get. Return: status label, version or 'test of draft revision N' with Simulate or Send to me, started and ended, endReason via endReasonText, the steps not used, and for each visited step its title (describeStep), status (Done/Failed/Skipped), when, attempt, stepNote, messageOf, decisionLines, knowledgeUsed and error.message. Return approvals with approvalDecidedLine. First move endReasonText, stepNote, messageOf, decisionLines and knowledgeUsed from apps/web/src/lib/workflows/run-words.ts into @hfos/core so both use one copy. Have list_workflow_runs' description name it, and have pageLines tell the model to call it when a run is on screen.

gaps.where: Workflow editor → Test tab: the test’s outcome (“Test passed, ready to publish.” / “The test didn’t pass. ‘X’ failed: …” / outdated / stopped), its step log, Stop the test; and the header gate “Run a test first” / “Tested, ready to publish”
gaps.gap: After the person confirms do_workflow_test, the model gets back only 'Done'. commitScreenAction returns no command output, so even the eventId never reaches it. list_workflow_runs never passes includeTests or onlyTests, so test runs can't be listed. get_workflow's WorkflowGet type and result leave out tested and testedRevision. So the Assistant can't tell whether the test passed or why it failed, can't tell whether Publish would be allowed, and can't find the test run to stop it with manage_workflow_run.
gaps.fix: Left open: after Confirm the test’s answer (its eventId, mode, revision) is now kept for the model (foundations step); tested/testedRevision and the publish gate in get_workflow, latestTest, list_workflow_runs tests, and finding the test run by triggerEventId are the workflows step’s. In getWorkflow (apps/worker/src/assistant/tools-content.ts:2390), return tested, testedRevision and a publishGate in the screen's words ('Run a test first' / 'Tested, ready to publish'). Also return latestTest, read from workflow.run_list {workflowId, onlyTests:true, limit:1}: runId, mode (Simulate or Send to me), status label, and for a failure the failed step's title and error message. Give list_workflow_runs a tests:boolean input that maps to onlyTests. Give do_workflow_test its own commit that returns the test's runId (workflow.run_list {triggerEventId}) and says 'The test is running; ask me how it went.'
